Summary: calculate heaping indicators

```{r}
## Library packages 
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))

## Read in dmf 
dmf <- fread(here("data", "censoc_dmf_clean.csv"))
```

## Heaping on birth year 

```{r}
## tabulated birth year 
tabulated_byear <- dmf %>% 
  filter(byear %in% c(1890:1915)) %>% 
  group_by(race) %>% 
  count(byear)

## create_plot
heaping_birth_year_plot <- tabulated_byear %>% 
  filter(!is.na(race)) %>% 
  mutate(fill_color = case_when(
    byear %in% seq(1885, 1920, by = 5) ~ "grey47",   # heaped years
    byear == 1884 ~ "white",
    TRUE ~ "white"
  )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = byear, y = n, fill = fill_color)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(label = scales::comma) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  facet_wrap(~race, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Birth Year (DMF)", 
       y = "Count") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f9f9f9", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey95"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    legend.position = "NULL",
    legend.justification = "center",  # centers the whole legend box
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) 
```


```{r}
whipple <- function(x) {
  # x is a vector of individual ages/years
  n_05    <- sum(x %% 10 %in% c(0, 5))
  n_total <- length(x)
  (n_05 / (n_total / 5)) * 100
}
```



```{r}
myers <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  start <- min(x)
  # align start to a decade boundary so each digit's cells line up
  base <- start - (start %% 10)
  max_x <- max(x)
  decades <- seq(base, max_x, by = 10)        # number of full decades K
  K <- length(decades)

  tab <- table(factor(x, levels = base:(base + 10 * K - 1)))
  counts <- as.integer(tab)
  m <- matrix(counts, nrow = 10)              # rows = digit 0..9, cols = decade

  # coefficient set 1: weight decade j (1-indexed) by j, starting digit's 1st occurrence
  w1 <- seq_len(K)
  # coefficient set 2: weight by (K-1)..0, starting digit's 2nd occurrence
  w2 <- c(0, rev(seq_len(K - 1)))

  blended <- as.numeric(m %*% w1 + m %*% w2)
  pct <- blended / sum(blended) * 100
  round(sum(abs(pct - 10)) / 2, 1)
}

whipple_adj <- function(x) {
  # Computes expected proportion of 0/5 terminal digits 
  # based on actual range, not assuming 2/10
  range_vals    <- min(x):max(x)
  expected_prop <- mean(range_vals %% 10 %in% c(0, 5))
  observed_prop <- mean(x %% 10 %in% c(0, 5))
  (observed_prop / expected_prop) * 100
}
```

```{r}
myers <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  lo <- min(x)   # round down to decade start
  hi <- max(x)             # round down to decade boundary


  tab <- as.data.frame(
    table(factor(x, levels = lo:max(x))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(tab) <- c("val", "n")
  tab$val <- as.integer(tab$val)

  DemoTools::check_heaping_myers(
    Value  = tab$n,
    Age    = tab$val,
    ageMin = lo,
    ageMax = hi
  )
}
```




```{r}
age_report_stats <- bind_rows(
  dmf %>% group_by(race) %>%
    summarise(whipple = whipple_adj(census_age), myers = myers(census_age)) %>% 
    mutate(variable = "Census Age"),
  dmf %>% group_by(race) %>% 
    summarise(whipple = whipple_adj(byear), myers = myers(byear)) %>% 
    mutate(variable = "Birth Year"),
  dmf %>% group_by(race) %>% 
    summarise(whipple = whipple_adj(death_age), myers = myers(death_age)) %>% 
    mutate(variable = "Age at Death"),
  dmf %>% group_by(race) %>% 
    summarise(whipple = whipple_adj(dyear), myers = myers(dyear)) %>% 
    mutate(variable = "Death Year")
) %>%
  select(variable, race, whipple, myers) %>%
  arrange(variable, race)


age_report_stats %>% 
  select(variable, race, whipple, myers) %>%
  arrange(variable, race) %>%
  rename(
    Variable = variable,
    Group    = race,
    Whipple  = whipple,
    Myers    = myers
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    format   = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption  = "Age Heaping Diagnostics for Linked CenSoc-DMF Sample",
    label    = "heaping",
    digits   = 1,
    na_string = "--"
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "none") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Index" = 2))  %>%
  save_kable(here("figures", "tab_heaping_diagnostics.tex"))
```
